title: test_authentication_login_and_registration
description: Verify that the authentication system supports user login and registration using JWT and Google OAuth, ensuring secure token handling and session management with timeout after 10 minutes of inactivity.

title: test_transaction_creation_and_export
description: Validate the creation, editing, and deletion of transactions with positive amount validation, multi-currency support, and attachment of receipts. Also verify export functionality for transactions filtered by month in CSV and Excel formats.

title: test_multi_currency_management
description: Test the CRUD operations for user-customizable currencies including adding, editing, activating/deactivating, deleting, and reordering currencies. Verify that the dashboard shows balances separated by each active currency.

title: test_category_management
description: Ensure that users can create, edit, delete, and activate/deactivate categories with custom icons, colors, and filters by income or expense type.

title: test_payment_methods_management
description: Verify management of payment methods including cash, credit cards, and transfers, with support for credit card limits and activation/deactivation.

title: test_savings_goals_creation_and_tracking
description: Validate creation and tracking of savings goals with visual progress indicators, automatic contributions from transactions, and multi-currency support.

title: test_dashboard_loading_and_widgets
description: Test that the dashboard loads within 3 seconds and displays widgets with multi-currency balances, recent transactions, categories, payment methods, and savings goals accurately.

title: test_credit_card_and_debt_tracking
description: Verify tracking of credit cards including limits, pending debts, scheduled payments, and that credit transactions do not affect balance until payment is made.

title: test_ai_agent_financial_queries_and_actions
description: Test the AI agent's ability to respond to financial queries, create transactions, provide summaries, and analyze spending patterns using the integrated tools.

title: test_session_timeout_and_security_modal
description: Ensure that the system shows a warning modal 2 minutes before session timeout due to inactivity and logs out the user after 10 minutes without response, handling token expiration securely.
